normative_extracts.spec_section: HTML Living Standard §10.2.3 Dedicated workers and the Worker interface
normative_extracts.quote: A Worker object creates an OS-level or isolated thread with its own event loop, global scope (DedicatedWorkerGlobalScope), and message queue, communicating with its creator via structured cloning or transferable ownership.

browser_support.notes: Module workers (type: 'module') are Baseline Widely Available across Chromium, Firefox 114+, and Safari 15+.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: The browser spawns an isolated JS engine instance (e.g., V8 Isolate) on an OS thread with no DOM access and communicates via asynchronous message ports.

production_failures.symptom: Main thread freezes for 120ms when sending a 25MB parsed dataset to a worker
production_failures.root_cause: postMessage(data) without a transfer list invokes the structured clone algorithm synchronously on the sender thread, copying every byte.
production_failures.mitigation: Pass underlying ArrayBuffers in the second argument transfer list: worker.postMessage(buf, [buf]).

production_failures.symptom: Memory leak and thread exhaustion after mounting a React component repeatedly
production_failures.root_cause: Each mount spawns new Worker() without calling worker.terminate() on unmount.
production_failures.mitigation: Pool long-lived workers at module scope or call worker.terminate() inside cleanup hooks.
